_meta.description: D6 fixtures for ms-agent-dotnet / a2ui-recovery (A2UI error recovery)
_meta._note: ms-agent-dotnet's RecoveryAgent (agent/RecoveryAgent.cs) is a raw-SSE MapPost endpoint, NOT a MapAGUI-mounted ChatClientAgent. It does NOT emit an outer generate_a2ui tool call and its narration text is hard-coded in C# (WriteNarrationAsync) — so the ONLY calls that reach aimock are the inner secondary render calls made by A2uiSecondaryToolCaller, whose tool name is `_design_a2ui_surface` (NOT render_a2ui like the Python slugs). RecoveryAgent forwards the FULL pill prompt verbatim as the inner call's user_content (ExtractLastUserText -> A2uiSecondaryToolCaller.GetDesignToolArgumentsAsync), re-sending the SAME content each attempt so aimock advances sequenceIndex (0 invalid -> 1 valid) to drive the heal retry. NO `context` match field: the recovery pills' prompts are GLOBALLY unique across every slug, so userMessage alone disambiguates (mirrors the langgraph-python reference; a real browser does not send x-aimock-context). Validation (RecoveryAgent.ValidateComponents): a surface is INVALID when a component's static `child`/`children` string references an id that is not defined (dangling_child_reference) or when no `root` component exists; it is VALID when a `root` exists and every static child reference resolves. HEAL: attempt 1 (seq 0) invalid (root -> missing child) -> retry -> attempt 2 (seq 1) valid (Column + two Metric tiles) -> paints declarative-metric x2. EXHAUST: invalid on every attempt (no valid seq) -> recovery exhausts -> a2ui_recovery_exhausted `failed` card. Repeat invocations: the HEAL sequenceIndex variants are followed by a NON-SEQUENCED fallback serving the same valid surface, so once slots 0 and 1 are spent (counters are per-X-Test-Id and never reset; a real browser sends no X-Test-Id) the inner render call still paints instead of falling through to the userMessage-only outer-emit fixture and exhausting. GOTCHAS.md's sanctioned repeat-invocation pattern.

fixtures._comment: HEAL pill - inner _design_a2ui_surface repeat-invocation FALLBACK. No sequenceIndex, ordered AFTER the two sequenced variants, serving the SAME valid surface as sequenceIndex 1. Load-bearing: aimock's sequenceIndex counters are bucketed per X-Test-Id and never reset within a bucket, and a real browser sends no X-Test-Id, so slots 0 and 1 are spent by the FIRST heal and every later heal skipped both gates and fell through to the userMessage-only outer-emit fixture below -- which serves generate_a2ui, not _design_a2ui_surface, so the recovery loop saw empty_components on all 3 attempts and painted the amber "Couldn't generate the UI" card while the narration still claimed success. With this fallback the first heal still stages invalid->retry->valid and every heal after it paints immediately. This is GOTCHAS.md's sanctioned repeat-invocation pattern (sequenceIndex variants + a non-sequenced fallback ordered after them) and the same stateless shape the EXHAUST pill above/below already uses.
